title: Zesty Lemon Loaf
description: This dressed-up pound cake-style zesty lemon loaf has a hint of ginger. The decadence of Grand Marnier makes this zesty lemon loaf recipe special.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brandy-based orange liqueur (such as Grand Marnier®)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease 2 loaf pans.

Sift flour, baking powder, ground ginger, and salt together in a bowl; set aside. Beat 2 cups sugar and butter together in a separate large bowl; beat in eggs. Stir in lemon zest and orange liqueur. Add buttermilk, then gently whisk in flour mixture. Pour batter into the prepared loaf pans.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick or small knife inserted into centers comes out clean, about 50 minutes. Remove from pans; transfer to a wire rack to cool.
Meanwhile, whisk remaining ¾ cup sugar and lemon juice together until sugar dissolves; gently drizzle over hot loaves. Cool loaves completely before serving.
